clearedSpotChecks.check: Swap events with amount0 = amount1 = 0 and price, tick and liquidity unchanged, which the step formulas cannot produce
clearedSpotChecks.note: Code read: PoolManager.swap reverts on amountSpecified == 0 (src/PoolManager.sol:193). Hooks.beforeSwap only changes amountToSwap when the hook has BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG (1 << 3, src/libraries/Hooks.sol:44) and returns a nonzero specified delta (src/libraries/Hooks.sol:265-277); the sign check there allows the sum to reach exactly 0. Pool.swap then returns ZERO_DELTA before the price limit checks and before any storage write (src/libraries/Pool.sol:320). For a nonzero amount computeSwapStep spends the whole exact-input amount as amountIn plus fee when the target is not reached (src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:76-82), and an exact-output step always books amountOut, so a nonzero amount cannot give a zero delta. On chain: the Tempo receipt of 0xbcdd279e8ecd3c87128831d33eb2f529339aa9a21dd9c9d609722e0b0e1bf591 (block 0x2e31500, status 1) holds a Swap log with amount0 = amount1 = 0 for pool 0x4f9788a8...cfd56, and eth_getLogs at block 41969958 on https://rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz returns its Initialize log with hooks 0x7169a78a59f136876e724b648fbb339a42f46888, fee 500, spacing 10. The hook's low bits 0x2888 set bit 3 and bit 7 (beforeSwap), as the item says. The zero swap needs the pool's own hook and moves no funds.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Pools initialized inside the window, where the parent block has an empty slot0
clearedSpotChecks.note: src/libraries/Pool.sol:100-107 writes slot0 from Slot0.wrap(bytes32(0)) with price, tick and lpFee only, so protocolFee starts at 0. PoolManager.initialize (src/PoolManager.sol:116-141) sets nothing else, and a later change needs setProtocolFee through the fee controller (src/libraries/Pool.sol:109-112). Starting the first swaps of a pool from its Initialize event is therefore correct. This only concerns the replay method and opens no path to funds.

clearedSpotChecks.note: Independent recompute with my own transcription of SqrtPriceMath and SwapMath (src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol, src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:51-105), not the unit's v4math: 17 Swap logs of 0xacb7e78fa05d562e0a5d3089ec896d57d057d38e in MegaETH blocks 32738493 to 32748493 from https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc, with slot0 and liquidity read by eth_getStorageAt at the parent block (pool base keccak(poolId, 6), liquidity at base + 3). 14 match a single exact-input step to the unit in price and output. The other 2 are multi-step swaps with unchanged liquidity: 0x572c01cb...6775 moves from tick 74332 to 74221 across a bitmap word boundary (word 290 to 289), and 0x6b75a4b4...8322 moves from tick 276331 to 276324 across initialized ticks 276331 and 276330 whose liquidityNet values (-4520037842146614 and +4520037842146614) cancel. The unit's full-loop replay lists both transactions in its MegaETH window as matched. 1 log was a swap whose liquidity changed and was not tested by me. Nothing contradicts the cleared item.
